
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19687410" title="发布于 2026-03-09 08:47">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于Microsoft.Extensions.AI 和 Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData构建向量搜索</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>今天简单看了看，基于Microsoft.Extensions.AI 和 Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData构建向量搜索。给大家分享分享。</p>
<p>首先，创建.NET 控制台应用，然后执行以下开发步骤</p>
<ul>
<li>通过为数据集生成嵌入内容来创建和填充向量存储。</li>
<li>为用户提示生成嵌入内容。</li>
<li>使用用户提示嵌入查询矢量存储。</li>
<li>显示矢量搜索的相关结果。</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>dotnet <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> console -o VectorDataAIDemo</pre>
</div>
<p>切换到以上</p>
<pre>VectorDataAIDemo</pre>
<p>目录下，安装以下Nuget包</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">dotnet add package Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI --prerelease
dotnet add package Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.Abstractions
dotnet add package Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.InMemory --prerelease
dotnet add package Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration
dotnet add package Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.UserSecrets
dotnet add package System.Linq.AsyncEnumerable</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI" data-linktype="external" rel="noopener nofollow">Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI</a>&nbsp;为 OpenAI 兼容的模型或终结点提供 AI 抽象。 此库还包括 OpenAI 服务 API 的官方&nbsp;<a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/OpenAI" data-linktype="external" rel="noopener nofollow">OpenAI</a>&nbsp;库作为依赖项。</li>
<li><a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.Abstractions" data-linktype="external" rel="noopener nofollow">Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.Abstractions</a>&nbsp;启用对向量存储的 Create-Read-Update-Delete (CRUD) 和搜索操作。</li>
<li><a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.InMemory" data-linktype="external" rel="noopener nofollow">Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.InMemory</a>&nbsp;提供内存中向量存储类来保存可查询向量数据记录。</li>
<li><a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration" data-linktype="external" rel="noopener nofollow">Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration</a>&nbsp;提供基于键值对的配置实现。</li>
<li><a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.UserSecrets" data-linktype="external" rel="noopener nofollow">Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.UserSecrets</a>&nbsp;是为&nbsp;<code>Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration</code>&nbsp;提供的用户机密配置程序实现。</li>
</ul>
<p>新建Class：CloudServiceWiki</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> VectorDataAIDemo;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CloudServiceWiki
{
    [VectorStoreKey]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Key { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [VectorStoreData]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [VectorStoreData]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Description { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [VectorStoreVector(
        Dimensions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">384</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        DistanceFunction </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DistanceFunction.CosineSimilarity)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ReadOnlyMemory&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt; Vector { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><a class="no-loc" href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.vectordata" data-linktype="absolute-path" rel="noopener nofollow">Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData</a>&nbsp;属性，例如&nbsp;<a class="no-loc" href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.vectordata.vectorstorekeyattribute" data-linktype="absolute-path" rel="noopener nofollow">VectorStoreKeyAttribute</a>，会影响在向量存储中使用时每个属性的处理方式。</p>
<p>该&nbsp;<code>Vector</code>&nbsp;属性存储生成的嵌入，表示&nbsp;<code>Description</code>&nbsp;值在矢量搜索中的语义含义。</p>
<p>在&nbsp;<code>Program.cs</code>&nbsp;文件中，添加以下代码以创建描述云服务知识库集合的数据集：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>List&lt;CloudServiceWiki&gt; cloudServices =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
[
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
            Key </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Azure App Service</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Host .NET, Java, Node.js, and Python web applications and APIs in a fully managed Azure service.     },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
            Key </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Azure Service Bus</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">A fully managed enterprise message broker supporting both point to point and publish-subscribe integrations. Azure Storage is highly scalable to store massive amounts of data and data is stored redundantly to ensure high availability.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
            Key </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Microsoft Entra ID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Manage user identities and control access to your apps, data, and resources.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
            Key </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Azure Key Vault</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Store and access application secrets like connection strings and API keys in an encrypted vault with restricted access to make sure your secrets and your application aren't compromised.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

            Description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Information retrieval at scale for traditional and conversational search applications, with security and options for AI enrichment and vectorization.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
];</span></pre>
</div>
<p>创建和配置&nbsp;<code>IEmbeddingGenerator</code>&nbsp;实现以将请求发送到嵌入 AI 模型：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Load the configuration values.</span>
IConfigurationRoot config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConfigurationBuilder().AddUserSecrets&lt;Program&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">().Build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> model = config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ModelName</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> key = config[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAIKey</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Create the embedding generator.</span>
IEmbeddingGenerator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, Embedding&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt;&gt; generator =
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClient(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(key))
      .GetEmbeddingClient(model: model)
      .AsIEmbeddingGenerator();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>使用云服务知识库数据创建和填充向量存储。 使用&nbsp;<code>IEmbeddingGenerator</code>&nbsp;实现为云服务知识库数据中的每个记录创建和分配嵌入向量：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Create and populate the vector store.</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> vectorStore = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InMemoryVectorStore();
VectorStoreCollection</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, CloudServiceWiki&gt; cloudServicesStore =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    vectorStore.GetCollection</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, CloudServiceWiki&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cloudServices</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cloudServicesStore.EnsureCollectionExistsAsync();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (CloudServiceWiki service <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cloudServices)
{
    service.Vector </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> generator.GenerateVectorAsync(service.Description);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cloudServicesStore.UpsertAsync(service);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>嵌入是每个数据记录语义含义的数字表示形式，这使得它们与向量搜索功能兼容。</p>
<p>搜索查询</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Convert a search query to a vector
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> and search the vector store.</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> query = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Which Azure service should I use to store my Word documents?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
ReadOnlyMemory</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span>&gt; queryEmbedding = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> generator.GenerateVectorAsync(query);

IAsyncEnumerable</span>&lt;VectorSearchResult&lt;CloudServiceWiki&gt;&gt; results =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    cloudServicesStore.SearchAsync(queryEmbedding, top: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (VectorSearchResult&lt;CloudServiceWiki&gt; result <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> results)
{
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Name: {result.Record.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Description: {result.Record.Description}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Vector match score: {result.Score}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
